claims.name: Experiments.AbstractLoopsPostprocessing.postprocess
assumptions: Supplied total functions trace : α → Trace and c : Trace → Output.
claims.statement: Closed deterministic postprocessing is the composite c ∘ trace.
claims.ceiling: Function composition only; it captures no storage or physical process.
claims.residual: Reachability and output restrictions are not modeled.

claims.name: Experiments.AbstractLoopsPostprocessing.postprocess_preserves_kernel
assumptions: Equality on Trace and Output is the selected comparison.
claims.statement: If two alternatives have equal trace values, every deterministic postprocessing gives them equal outputs.
claims.ceiling: One-way preservation of trace collisions for this composite function.
claims.residual: No converse or physical persistence claim.

claims.name: Experiments.AbstractLoopsPostprocessing.fresh_xor_observation_changes_aperture
assumptions: The C1 Bool×Bool XOR answer and coordinate traces are used.
claims.statement: The first coordinate does not certify XOR, while the joint pair of coordinates does certify it.
claims.ceiling: Finite Boolean illustration that a newly included observation changes the interface's certifying power.
claims.residual: No general observation or acquisition dynamics.

claims.name: Experiments.AbstractLoopsPostprocessing.fresh_xor_pair_not_closed_postprocess
assumptions: The declared Bool×Bool world and Bool first-coordinate trace.
claims.statement: No deterministic postprocessing of the first XOR coordinate equals the pair-valued joint trace.
claims.ceiling: This specific fresh pair observation is not a closed postprocessing of the first coordinate.
claims.residual: Other source traces or modelled inputs may carry the missing distinction.

claims.name: Experiments.AbstractLoopsPostprocessing.scheduledIteration
assumptions: Supplied initial map and total update family step : Nat → State → State.
claims.statement: Scheduled state evolution applies the indexed deterministic update at each successor step.
claims.ceiling: Recursive function over a declared schedule only.
claims.residual: No runtime, physical, or autonomous-loop semantics.

claims.name: Experiments.AbstractLoopsPostprocessing.scheduled_iteration_preserves_kernel
assumptions: Each scheduled update is a total deterministic function; equality is the chosen kernel relation.
claims.statement: If two alternatives have equal states at step n, they have equal states at step n+1.
claims.residual: No fresh observations or rereading are modeled.

claims.name: Experiments.AbstractLoopsPostprocessing.kernelPairs
assumptions: Finite World, decidable equality on World and State; equality defines the observation fibers.
claims.statement: kernelPairs records all ordered world pairs that a state observation maps to equal values.
claims.ceiling: Finite encoding of a function kernel.

claims.name: Experiments.AbstractLoopsPostprocessing.finite_relation_chain_stabilizes
assumptions: α is finite; each relations n is a finite subset of α; inclusion is monotone at each successor.
claims.statement: Every inclusion-monotone sequence of relations over a finite carrier is eventually constant.
claims.ceiling: Finite-set order result; it applies in particular to finite partition relations but does not assert a physical or infinite-domain result.
claims.residual: The stabilization index is existential, with no explicit bound returned.

claims.name: Experiments.AbstractLoopsPostprocessing.finite_scheduled_partition_stabilizes
assumptions: World is finite; State has decidable equality; updates form the supplied total family step : Nat → State → State.
claims.statement: The equality-kernel partitions of scheduled deterministic processing on a finite World are eventually constant.
claims.ceiling: Finite alternative-domain model; only induced equality partitions are stabilized.
claims.residual: No result for infinite World with merely finite reachable trace image, infinite reachable state, or physical storage/cycle behavior.

claims.name: Experiments.AbstractLoopsPostprocessing.booleanSwap
claims.statement: booleanSwap exchanges the two Boolean state values.

claims.name: Experiments.AbstractLoopsPostprocessing.boolean_swap_kernel_unchanged
assumptions: Two-valued Bool state; kernel means equality of observed state.
claims.statement: Boolean swapping changes state values but leaves the equality kernel over Bool unchanged.
claims.residual: No general invariant or persistence claim.

claims.name: Experiments.AbstractLoopsPostprocessing.boolean_swap_has_two_cycle
claims.statement: Applying booleanSwap twice returns the original Boolean value.
claims.ceiling: A two-cycle fixture for the stated map.

manual_dispositions.detail: P0043 explicitly excludes physical destruction, entropy increase, and ontological disappearance from the informational model.
P0045-P0046's infinite-alternative case with finite reachable trace image, fresh-input behavior, and physical loop interpretations are not formalized here.
